author: Lintuxer
tagline: Photo, video, design, office and CAD apps in your browser
description:
Nine open-source apps written in Rust, served from your ZimaOS box and running entirely
in the browser:

- PhotoCraft: raster image editor with layers, masks and PSD files
- LightCraft: non-destructive photo editor with a photo library
- FilmCraft: nonlinear video editor
- EffectCraft: motion graphics and compositing
- DesignCraft: page and layout design
- DeckCraft: presentations and slide shows
- GridCraft: spreadsheets
- PdfCraft: PDF reader and editor
- CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting

The start page links to each app. Your box only serves the app files: there is no
server-side code, no database and no volume, so nothing you open is stored on it. Apps
that keep settings or a library keep them in the browser you use. Save or export your
work before closing the tab.

Over plain HTTP the apps draw with WebGL2. WebGPU and the clipboard need HTTPS.

Based on the Craft apps by the ArtCraft team (https://github.com/storytold), under
MIT OR Apache-2.0. This package is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

tips.before_install:
The start page is published on port 8088. Change it in the form below if that port
is taken. Every app is in early development upstream: save your work often.
